Inside the Data Layer at a Glance: From Web Crawl to Training Batch

The data supply chain of an AI factory on one page: the eight stages that turn the web, books, code, licensed archives, synthetic text and human judgement into training batches; the numbers, players and risks at each; a trace of one document through the whole chain; and a strategy builder. Everything links to the eight-part series.

⚠️ About the numbers. Everything here comes from the eight articles (as of 27 October 2026), which cite their sources. Figures marked ⚠️ are reported or secondary; private-company revenues and deal sizes are press reports; shares by stage, the strategy builder and quiz are editorial. The legal summary is not legal advice.
